hypotheses.justification: The identity of the integrals and hence the tendsto conclusion hold for arbitrary B. `setIntegral_parabolic_to_product` and `MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb` do not require the integrated set to be measurable. The proof uses hB only to apply `setIntegral_congr_ae`; those two congruences can instead use the integrands' pointwise equality and equality of integrals under function equality, which needs no measurability of B. The integrals over a nonmeasurable B are still well-defined set integrals, so this does not rely on excluding a degenerate case.
